name: Spelle (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Spelle (a yellow tower between trees and a plough on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Spelle; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Spelle arms — tower, trees and plough on blue
